paper.experiment: single vertical cut through a banana
paper.reported_force_channels: total resistance includes material and rigid-support reactions
paper.sampling: pointwise mean over 20 simulations with different particle samplings at the same resolution
paper.refinement: one-quarter grid spacing and 64 times as many particles
unpublished_fields: banana geometry and physical specimen dimensions
base grid spacing and force-experiment timestep
normal response, tangential stiffness and damping scales
numerical end-effector trajectory and controller gains
raw robot and simulation force samples

geometry.shape: authored curved voxel banana; not a scan of the paper specimen

sampling.method: one equal-volume point per base particle voxel with deterministic uniform stratified jitter

trajectory.kind: vertical PD target for a dynamic translation-only knife

refinement.construction: split every unjittered base particle voxel into 4 x 4 x 4 equal-volume children

force_definition.excluded_from_resistance: drive_force_n; it is recorded as the actuation input

execution_boundary: This protocol can test numerical repeatability and refinement of the independent DexLab model. With no author trajectory, contact scales, specimen geometry or raw robot trace, it cannot establish an exact reproduction or real-banana accuracy.
